whoIsThisFor.heading: Who is the Financial Services Cloud Accredited Professional exam for?

personas.label: Banking and wealth management consultants
personas.description: You configure Salesforce for a bank, wealth manager or financial adviser.

personas.label: Salesforce admins at financial firms
personas.description: You administer Financial Services Cloud and work with households, accounts and rollups.

personas.label: Insurance and fintech implementation partners
personas.description: You implement FSC and need to understand relationships, referrals and client workflows.

examDifficulty.heading: Is the Financial Services Cloud Accredited Professional Exam Hard?
examDifficulty.summary: The exam covers Financial Services Cloud records and workflows, including people, households, financial accounts, relationships, rollups, referrals and action plans.
bullets: 50 scored questions in 75 minutes, plus up to five unscored questions that do not count.
56% to pass, which is 28 correct answers out of 50.
Data model focus. Person accounts, households, financial accounts, roles and relationships.
Industry features. Rollups, referrals, action plans, interaction summaries and compliant data sharing.
examDifficulty.passRateGuidance: In a trial org, create a household with members and financial accounts. Check how balances roll up, then use practice questions to find areas for review.

examFormat.heading: Financial Services Cloud Accredited Professional Exam Format Explained
examFormat.intro: Accredited Professional exams are taken online. Use the current official guide for the latest format and registration details.
examFormat.scenarioPercent: Scenarios describe a client or adviser need. Identify the people and accounts involved, then choose the relationship, workflow or access control that fits.
bestWayToPass: Identify the people, household, financial account and role records in each scenario.
Check how household membership and rollups are configured in the org.
Use relationship records to connect people or businesses, and referrals to route client needs.
Review sharing and permissions before treating a record as confidential.

certificationCard.description: This exam covers the FSC client model, household relationships, financial accounts and rollups, referrals, action plans and data access. The exam is 50 scored questions in 75 minutes, with a 56% pass mark, weighted towards Delivery (46%) and Define/Design (42%).

keyConcepts.h2: Financial Services Cloud: Key Concepts for the Exam

blocks.heading: FSC Data Model: Households, Individuals, and Financial Accounts
blocks.body: Financial Services Cloud adds financial records and relationship features to Salesforce. Financial Accounts represent accounts such as deposits or investments; Financial Account Roles connect people to those accounts and describe their roles. Financial Holdings can represent positions within investment accounts. Assets, liabilities and goals capture other parts of a client’s financial picture. Household and rollup behavior depends on the configured data model and rollup settings.

blocks.heading: Relationship Management and Referrals
blocks.body: Households and other relationship groups help advisers understand connected clients. Contact-to-contact relationships link people, while account-to-account relationships link businesses. Referrals can route a client need to another employee or team. Use the relationship type that matches the parties involved.

blocks.heading: Action Plans for Client Lifecycle Management
blocks.body: An action plan turns a template into a repeatable set of tasks, such as client onboarding. Tasks can have due dates and assignments, and the plan can be linked to records such as accounts or opportunities. Teams can follow progress as the work is completed.

blocks.heading: Rollup Summaries and Financial Aggregations
blocks.body: FSC rollups can summarize financial account balances for a person or household. Rollup by lookup rules identify the records and fields to include. Review how ownership and joint-account settings affect totals, and how recalculation works after a data load.

blocks.heading: Compliance, KYC, and Document Management
blocks.body: Financial firms need to limit access to sensitive client information. Compliant data sharing can grant access based on a person’s role in a client or deal team. Review confidentiality for interaction summaries, identity-check records, document reviews, audit history, and event monitoring.

scenarioTips.h2: How to Pass the Salesforce Financial Services Cloud Accredited Professional Exam
scenarioTips.intro: Read the client situation first, then select the record or process that represents it.

blocks.heading: Represent people separately
blocks.body: Use individual client records and connect them to a household where the implementation calls for one.

blocks.heading: Link owners to accounts
blocks.body: Financial Account Roles describe each person’s connection to a financial account.

blocks.heading: Treat totals as configured rollups
blocks.body: Verify the rollup setup and recalculate totals when a data load requires it.

blocks.heading: Protect sensitive information
blocks.body: Use configured sharing and permissions; a label or summary alone does not restrict access.

nextCertsAfter.heading: Next Certifications After This AP
nextCertsAfter.intro: Good next steps after Financial Services Cloud:

sampleQuestions.question: How should FSC represent three family members who share some bank accounts?
options: Separate person accounts grouped in one household
One Opportunity with three linked Contacts
One shared person account for the entire family
sampleQuestions.explanation: Separate person accounts grouped in one household is the best fit because each person is a person account, and the household groups them while keeping each one's details separate.
whyWrong: One Opportunity with three linked Contacts is not the best choice because an Opportunity is a deal, not a family.
One shared person account for the entire family is not the best choice because one account for three people loses individual details.
Three separate lead records is not the best choice because leads are for prospects, not clients.

sampleQuestions.question: What connects two joint owners to the same financial account?
options: A Contact relationship with no account role
Financial Account Roles for both owners
An Action Plan for the account
Two copies of the same account
sampleQuestions.explanation: Financial Account Roles for both owners is the best fit because financial account roles connect one financial account to each person, with their role such as joint owner.
whyWrong: A Contact relationship with no account role is not the best choice because contact relationships link people, not accounts.
An Action Plan for the account is not the best choice because action plans are task lists.
Two copies of the same account is not the best choice because copies would double-count the balance.

sampleQuestions.question: Which capability can show a household total derived from its financial accounts?
options: Add a formula field to each person record
Add the balances by hand in a spreadsheet
sampleQuestions.explanation: Configured household rollups is the best fit because fSC rollups add up balances from financial accounts to people and their household.
whyWrong: Add a formula field to each person record is not the best choice because formulas can't sum across related financial accounts.
Email a report every week is not the best choice because a weekly email is not live data.
Add the balances by hand in a spreadsheet is not the best choice because spreadsheets go out of date.

sampleQuestions.question: How can a teller route a client’s mortgage interest to a lending specialist?
options: Post to the entire bank in Chatter
sampleQuestions.explanation: Referral to the mortgage team is the best fit because referrals pass leads to the right expert, and need-based routing sends them to the right person or queue.
whyWrong: Create an Action Plan is not the best choice because a broad post may be missed and isn't tracked.
Post to the entire bank in Chatter is not the best choice because updating the address doesn't pass the lead.
Change the client address is not the best choice because it does not meet the scenario as directly as Create and route a referral to the mortgage team.

sampleQuestions.question: Which feature can give each new client the same twelve onboarding tasks?
options: An Action Plan Template for each client onboarding
A Financial Goal for the onboarding process
A report listing the twelve steps
A separate household record for each step
sampleQuestions.explanation: An Action Plan Template for each client onboarding is the best fit because action plan templates create the same set of tasks each time, with due dates and owners.
whyWrong: A Financial Goal for the onboarding process is not the best choice because reports show data.
A report listing the twelve steps is not the best choice because households group people.
A separate household record for each step is not the best choice because it does not meet the scenario as directly as An Action Plan Template for each client onboarding.

sampleQuestions.question: Where can an adviser record funds held inside a client’s investment account?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Financial Holdings is the best fit because financial holdings record the securities or funds within an investment account.
whyWrong: Interaction summaries is not the best choice because referrals pass leads.
Referrals is not the best choice because households group people.
Separate household records is not the best choice because it does not meet the scenario as directly as Financial Holdings related to the investment account.

sampleQuestions.question: How should an adviser record a house and a mortgage held at another bank?
options: Cases recorded for property or debt
sampleQuestions.explanation: Assets and liabilities is the best fit because assets and liabilities record things owned or owed that aren't financial accounts at the firm.
whyWrong: Cases recorded for property or debt is not the best choice because holdings are investments inside an account.
Financial holdings for investment positions is not the best choice because it does not meet the scenario as directly as Assets and liabilities.
Leads for external obligations is not the best choice because leads are prospects.

sampleQuestions.question: Which access approach limits an Opportunity to members of the client’s deal team?
options: Set organization-wide access to Public Read/Write
Restrict sharing to the relevant deal-team roles
sampleQuestions.explanation: Restrict sharing to the relevant deal-team roles is the best fit because compliant data sharing grants access based on roles in the relationship or deal, which meets privacy needs.
whyWrong: Give all users View All is not the best choice because it does not meet the scenario as directly as Restrict sharing to the relevant deal-team roles.
Delete the Opportunities is not the best choice because removing data isn't a solution.
Set organization-wide access to Public Read/Write is not the best choice because public access shows the data to everyone.

sampleQuestions.question: How should an adviser record a sensitive meeting when visibility must be restricted?
options: An Account field visible to every employee
A Chatter post visible to the branch
An email sent to the whole branch
sampleQuestions.explanation: Restricted interaction summary is the best fit because interaction summaries record meetings and can be marked confidential to limit who can see them.
whyWrong: An Account field visible to every employee is not the best choice because a field visible to all defeats the point.
A Chatter post visible to the branch is not the best choice because a public post is visible to many people.
An email sent to the whole branch is not the best choice because emailing the branch spreads the notes.

sampleQuestions.question: Which relationship record can link a client with their accountant?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Contact relationship is the best fit because contact-contact relationships link people, such as a client and their adviser or accountant.
whyWrong: A household is not the best choice because holdings are investments.
A Financial Holding is not the best choice because it does not meet the scenario as directly as A Contact-to-Contact Relationship.
A Financial Account Role is not the best choice because financial account roles link people to accounts.

sampleQuestions.question: What can an admin run if household totals need refreshing after a large data load?
options: Ask advisers to edit each account
sampleQuestions.explanation: Bulk rollup recalculation is the best fit because bulk recalculation updates rollup totals after large data loads.
whyWrong: Delete the households is not the best choice because it does not meet the scenario as directly as Run the configured bulk rollup recalculation.
Change the page layout is not the best choice because layouts don't affect totals.
Ask advisers to edit each account is not the best choice because editing accounts one by one isn't practical.

sampleQuestions.question: Which FSC record tracks a long-term savings target for university costs?
sampleQuestions.explanation: A Financial Goal is the best fit because financial goals track targets like education or retirement savings and progress toward them.
whyWrong: A liability is not the best choice because it does not meet the scenario as directly as A Financial Goal.
An Action Plan is not the best choice because action plans list tasks.
A referral is not the best choice because referrals pass leads.

sampleQuestions.question: How can FSC show that a subsidiary business is related to its parent?
sampleQuestions.explanation: An Account-to-Account Relationship is the best fit because account-account relationships link businesses, such as a parent and subsidiary.
whyWrong: A household is not the best choice because it does not meet the scenario as directly as An Account-to-Account Relationship.
A Contact-to-Contact Relationship is not the best choice because contact relationships link people.
A Financial Account Role is not the best choice because roles link people to financial accounts.

sampleQuestions.question: What evidence can the firm record to document a client identity check for KYC?
options: Record nothing because KYC happens outside Salesforce
Keep dated identity-check records, documents and outcomes
Add a Financial Goal to the profile
Post a Chatter note that the check is complete
sampleQuestions.explanation: Keep dated identity-check records, documents and outcomes is the best fit because recording identity checks and documents with dates gives a clear audit trail for KYC.
whyWrong: Record nothing because KYC happens outside Salesforce is not the best choice because firms need evidence, wherever the check is done.
Add a Financial Goal to the profile is not the best choice because goals are savings targets.
Post a Chatter note that the check is complete is not the best choice because a post isn't a reliable record.

sampleQuestions.question: What does an FSC household represent?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Household group is the best fit because households group people through account-contact relationships, with a primary member.
whyWrong: A single-member-only record is not the best choice because financial accounts are still needed to hold balances.
A replacement for Financial Accounts is not the best choice because it does not meet the scenario as directly as A group of people represented through the FSC relationship model.
A Lead type is not the best choice because households are accounts, not leads.
